cards.title: Sources of IVIVE Error and Measurement Challenges
cards.claim: Systematic underprediction in IVIVE is multifactorial, stemming from limitations in in vitro systems (e.g., enzyme activity loss, cofactor depletion), measurement errors (e.g., fraction unbound), and biological complexities (e.g., unstirred water layer, protein-facilitated uptake). Low clearance compounds are difficult to measure accurately due to low turnover rates.
conditions: Particularly relevant for low CLint compounds where experimental noise is high relative to signal.
required_inputs: Knowledge of in vitro system limitations (microsomes vs. hepatocytes).
Awareness of potential binding artifacts (e.g., long-chain fatty acids in microsomes).
limitations: The exact mechanism for CLH-dependent underprediction remains undetermined.
Donor variability and cryopreservation effects are noted but not fully resolved in the literature cited.
cards.downstream_use: Contextualize uncertainty in PK/PD modeling. When interpreting IVIVE-derived parameters, acknowledge that underprediction is a known bias, especially for high ER compounds, and that low CLint measurements have high uncertainty.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
